title: The Alpha–Omega Thermometric Graduation
deck:
The Alpha–Omega graduation treats thermal intensity as a continuous
            index of Alpha-Axis oscillation rather than a quantized substance
            called energy.

concise.body:
The Omega Gradation of the Cyclic Interaction, the thermometric scale of TUIDG

In TUIDG, the term energy, in the sense of a total conversion of matter, of an indefinite fragmentation of matter, as if it were transformed into an "infinitely fine dust," also does not exist, much less the term "quantization of energy," referring to the impossibility of intermediate levels existing between one value, considered the smallest, and any other.

The formulation of the "Omega Graduation of Cyclic Interaction" establishes a rigorous departure from the dogmas of modern physics, replacing probabilistic abstractions with a geometric, continuous mechanics grounded in pure reason.

By eliminating the concept of "pure energy" (as an ethereal substance or pulverized matter) and the idea of ​​"quantization," TUIDG restores continuity and structural causality.

The Pillars of this Thermometric Scale

Continuity versus Quantization: The rejection of the minimum "quantum" implies that movement and interaction do not occur in discrete, inexplicable "jumps." Continuous intermediate levels exist in the oscillation of the Compalphas' axes, rendering cyclic interaction a perfectly fluid process.

Strictly Kinetic Nature: The term "energy" is stripped of its mystique.

Indestructibility and Non-conversion: Matter does not convert into abstract, immaterial "energy." The structural integrity of the Merons is maintained; what changes along the thermometric scale is merely the magnitude and frequency of the cyclic interaction between their axes.

Thus, what exists is the Cyclic Interaction, the oscillation-vibration of the Alpha Axes, which are the "intrinsic magnetic moments" of the Compalphas, the constituents of the Merons (atoms), and in it, "kinetic energy" increases in a continuous manner, without "magical jumps," as a function of the increase of the angle of oscillation-vibration of the axes of these Compalphas, since it is defined simply by the oscillatory amplitude of these axes.

As the oscillatory amplitude of the Alpha Axes, in the Cyclic Interaction, reaches individual excursions of +60° and −60°, producing 120° peak-to-peak, at least until the rupture of the Meronic Circle, therefore of the entire Meronic structure, this means that all "kinetic energy" perceptible in the structures of Apparent Matter, which are not in the process of fission or nuclear fusion, or rather, which are not in "Meronic construction or deconstruction," is contained within a range of only 120 (60) equal parts, therefore, each one of these parts obviously represents a great deal of "kinetic energy."

However, 120 (60) parts is far too little to encompass, for example, the 1,162 parts of the range corresponding to the thermal variation necessary to melt iron, which is from 373 K to 1535°C.

Each one of these almost 26 million equal parts, which determine, so to speak, "quantized fractions of vibrational energy," in TUIDG, is called an Omega Degree, the equivalents of "thermal," "luminous," "electrical," that is, "electromagnetic" intensity, expressed by conventional degree scales, that is, each Omega Degree may be equal to 1 degree centigrade; it only remains for us to verify this equivalence.

All "apparent oscillation/vibration" (kinetic energy) of the universe may be classified into three principal groups.

full.body:
The Omega Gradation of the Cyclic Interaction, the thermometric scale of TUIDG

In TUIDG, the term energy, in the sense of a total conversion of matter, of an indefinite fragmentation of matter, as if it were transformed into an "infinitely fine dust," also does not exist, much less the term "quantization of energy," referring to the impossibility of intermediate levels existing between one value, considered the smallest, and any other. In this theory there does not exist a minimum "quantum" of "energy," and the term "energy" always comes accompanied by the term "kinetic," since the "oscillations/vibrations" of the axes of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons are an "energy of movement," therefore, a "kinetic energy."

The formulation of the "Omega Graduation of Cyclic Interaction" establishes a rigorous departure from the dogmas of modern physics, replacing probabilistic abstractions with a geometric, continuous mechanics grounded in pure reason.

By eliminating the concept of "pure energy" (as an ethereal substance or pulverized matter) and the idea of ​​"quantization," TUIDG restores continuity and structural causality. Thermal measurement ceases to be a statistical phenomenon involving random particles and becomes the direct measurement of the mechanical transmission of a structural frequency.

The Pillars of this Thermometric Scale

Continuity versus Quantization: The rejection of the minimum "quantum" implies that movement and interaction do not occur in discrete, inexplicable "jumps." Continuous intermediate levels exist in the oscillation of the Compalphas' axes, rendering cyclic interaction a perfectly fluid process.

Strictly Kinetic Nature: The term "energy" is stripped of its mystique. It is returned to its most logical definition: intrinsic movement. Thermal energy is, therefore, exclusively the kinetic energy generated by the mechanical oscillations and vibrations of the toroidal fields that form the Merons.

Indestructibility and Non-conversion: Matter does not convert into abstract, immaterial "energy." The structural integrity of the Merons is maintained; what changes along the thermometric scale is merely the magnitude and frequency of the cyclic interaction between their axes.

This definition establishes the "Omega Graduation" not as a measure of abstract heat, but as a precise index of the intensity of continuous mechanical movement within the geometric model.

Thus, what exists is the Cyclic Interaction, the oscillation-vibration of the Alpha Axes, which are the "intrinsic magnetic moments" of the Compalphas, the constituents of the Merons (atoms), and in it, "kinetic energy" increases in a continuous manner, without "magical jumps," as a function of the increase of the angle of oscillation-vibration of the axes of these Compalphas, since it is defined simply by the oscillatory amplitude of these axes. This is to say that, between any two values of angular variation (of energy), there may exist infinitely many others.

By this understanding, that which conventional physicists call the spectral lines of a substance, as being "quantized energy transitions" or "discrete packets of energy" emitted by their supposed "electrons," are in truth merely "quantized oscillations," that is, they are the result of the different "oscillation amplitudes" of the axes of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons of that substance, which are oscillating at a certain "quantized amplitude" at the moment of measurement, as a function of the level of "kinetic energy" supplied to the system and of the oscillatory permissions of the axes of the Compalphas in each type of substance, or in each different type of Meron.

As the angular displacements of the axes of the Compalphas of a substance are "oscillatory," that is, they are "pendular movements," which occur about the Alpha Points, any index of displacement of these axes generates a sinusoidal function along a chain of axes, as a "mechanical wave" propagating along a string, for the values oscillate between positive and negative with equilibrium at the initial position. Thus, if a physical system, such as, for example, the filament of an incandescent lamp, is oscillating-vibrating as a function of a certain temperature or electrical voltage supplied to it, the axes of the Compalphas that constitute its Merons will oscillate-vibrate always at the same amplitude, hence the idea that there exists a quantum corresponding to each "energy level" and, consequently, a type of "particle" with a certain "mass" or "momentum" associated with such quantum.

Thus, according to the Cyclic Interaction, all quantifiable "kinetic energy" in the universe being given solely as a function of the different amplitudes of angular displacements of the axes of the Compalphas, what we must do to organize this new "thermometric scale" is to establish a range of angular values that encompasses all the values that are perceptible by measuring instruments (thermometers).

As the oscillatory amplitude of the Alpha Axes, in the Cyclic Interaction, reaches individual excursions of +60° and −60°, producing 120° peak-to-peak, at least until the rupture of the Meronic Circle, therefore of the entire Meronic structure, this means that all "kinetic energy" perceptible in the structures of Apparent Matter, which are not in the process of fission or nuclear fusion, or rather, which are not in "Meronic construction or deconstruction," is contained within a range of only 120 (60) equal parts, therefore, each one of these parts obviously represents a great deal of "kinetic energy."

However, 120 (60) parts is far too little to encompass, for example, the 1,162 parts of the range corresponding to the thermal variation necessary to melt iron, which is from 373 K to 1535°C. And even if we multiply these 120 (60) degrees by 60 minutes of arc, we will have only 7,200 (3,600) parts, which is still little compared to what is lacking to reach the range of "energy" of "nuclear fusion," which is on the order of some millions of degrees. And if we multiply these 7,200 (3,600) parts by a further 60 seconds of arc, we will obtain only a range of 432,000 (216,000) parts, which is also still little. Now, if we multiply this value by a further 60 parts, we will then have a range of 2,592,0000 (12,960,000) parts, that is, ∼26 million degrees, which is already quite reasonable.

Each one of these almost 26 million equal parts, which determine, so to speak, "quantized fractions of vibrational energy," in TUIDG, is called an Omega Degree, the equivalents of "thermal," "luminous," "electrical," that is, "electromagnetic" intensity, expressed by conventional degree scales, that is, each Omega Degree may be equal to 1 degree centigrade; it only remains for us to verify this equivalence.

All "apparent oscillation/vibration" (kinetic energy) of the universe may be classified into three principal groups. All amplitudes (the frequency of conventional radiation) that are inferior to those of the Light Amplitude (light), are called Infra-luminous Amplitudes, and all those that are superior to those of light, are called Ultra-luminous Amplitudes. As examples of Infra-light amplitudes, let there be the traditional microwaves, short waves, radio and TV waves, etc., and as Ultra-light amplitudes, let there be the radiations that go from ultraviolet to gamma rays and beyond.
